scenes.name: DIVISION OF LABOR
lines: Forget the lone magic chatbot. Real companies run on division of labor and signed accountability.
忘掉无所不能的单一聊天框。真实公司靠的是清晰分工与可审计责任。
For December seventeenth, six AI employee roles cover seventy-seven of ninety-seven operational workflows.
为十二月十七日发布会，六个 AI 员工岗位覆盖了九十七项真实流程中的七十七项。

scenes.name: SIX ROLES
lines: Six scoped AI employee roles staff this launch: Concierge Donna—partnered with Flower Town's Blossom—plus Community, Social Auto-X, Finance, HR, and Admin.
六个边界清晰的 AI 员工岗位值守这场发布会：礼宾 Donna（协同花店小花）、社群、社媒 Auto-X、财务、HR 与行政。

scenes.name: HUMAN GATES
lines: And the remaining twenty workflows stay behind human gates or on the roadmap—money out, contracts signed, and off-script press claims.
剩下的二十项流程留守人类闸门或路线图——资金划转、合同签署与库外媒体表态。
Honest boundaries are what turn a demo into an employee you can actually hire.
诚实的边界，才让一个演示变成你真正敢雇佣的员工。
